           GUARANA

        Guarana

        (PAULLINIA SORBILIS)


Contains a large percentage of Caffeine, which may explain its use as a
        remedy for certain forms os sick headache.



Head.--  Intellectual excitement. Sick headache in persons who
        have used tea and coffee in excess. Throbbing headache after use of liquor.



Bowels.--  Stools profuse, bloody, bright green; flakes
        inter-mixed; odorless. Cholera infantum.



Skin.--  Chloasmata on temples and arms. Urticaria (  Dulc; Apis; Chloral  ).



Sleep.--  Uncontrollable sleepiness and heaviness of head, with
        flushed face after eating.



Dose.--  Must be given in material doses-fifteen to sixty grains
        of the powder.
